title: Chapter 1063
paragraphs: Chapter 1063
Episode 252. The War Begins (2)
Screeeeech...!
The moment the phoenix Tess's roar echoed across the battlefield, everyone present was engulfed in the same sensation.
The sky felt heavy, an unfamiliar sensation.
There was no other way to describe it. Even the alliance members inside the ships felt as though something gigantic was pressing down on their heads.
Pressure, the authority contained within Tess's blue flames.
Summoned in no time, Tess appeared larger and more majestic than ever before. Positioned above the ship Sara, Tess surveyed the battlefield.
Wherever Tess's gaze landed, blue flames sprouted. Especially around the Tower of Story, the flames fiercely bloomed as if encasing the tower.
As always.
Ziffle, would attempt to escape the blue flames through manipulation and distortion.
But Jin saw it clearly. To him and the warriors, it was evident that Ziffle could not easily accomplish that task.
Even the manipulation ability of the Origin Stone was affected by the pressure.
Crackle, hiss, squeak...!
The first to react to the pressure were Ziffle's fleet and Usrok formed near the Divine Fleet.
Despite not yet touching the blue flames directly, they wavered as if moths were losing their strength in the heat.
The fleet formed by Ziffle had chaotic black lines drawn across its hull, showing signs of tearing and fading, as if an illusion was being dispelled.
The essence of the forces formed by the Origin Stone is that they are 'fakes.' Eternal Flames was a power too overwhelming for such fakes to withstand.
While the Origin Stone's ability itself was not false, the fleet could not sustain indefinitely, though it did not completely vanish.
Eternal Flames were only just beginning.
Swoosh...!
Bramante was unsheathed.
It seemed as if several streams of blue rivers unfolded in the sky.
Jin began to advance towards the Tower of Story, stepping on a flowing stream of blue flames. A vast expanse of flames surged around him.
"Wow, it's like a part of the flame realm has been recreated... I wonder how the real Sara would feel seeing this on the ship Sara."
The first flagship of Runkandel, the ship Sara.
Sara was not only equipped with the alliance's latest technology but also magic developed by Tess, Ameris, Lucy, Valeria, and Jin.
They slightly modified the formula of Eternal Flames and engraved runes inspired by it onto the ship.
In essence, Sara became a ship capable of enhancing the magic sword technique Eternal Flames.

It wasn't just about expanding the territory and boosting destructive power. The technology and magic applied to Sara eased the conditions for Tess's manifestation and even reduced Jin's physical exhaustion.
Of course, this didn't mean Tess could fully manifest at will. However, even that stage was now within reach, given enough time.
[Murakan would be very pleased, and for Ziffle, this sword will become an even greater nightmare than a thousand years ago.]

Liet answered. She was no longer just a steward but now the vice-captain of the ship Sara, taking on more responsibilities. Liet and Valeria, both with recording abilities, would be key in all upcoming battles.
Jin rapidly closed the distance to the Tower of Story.
The wildly churning blue flames were no longer mere streams but had expanded into a vast sea, pressing against the tower.
However, the speed of advancement gradually slowed. While the blue flames weakened the manipulation and distortion powers, the Tower of Story was not just that.
Its vast hull was protected by countless magic spells. Thousands of layers of shields and Ziffle's elite magicians within.
The pressure had not yet penetrated the hull's interior, and the Origin Stone's power grew stronger closer to the tower's core.
Inside, the Origin Stone continuously formed fake troops. They, mixed with real grand magicians, were attacking Jin.
"Deploy chain magic, to all phantom army locations!"
Phantom army, ghost army, demon spirits, and White Night.
All those staffs were aimed at Jin. Amidst a flurry of grand magic, Jin calmly wielded the blue flames, swallowing their attacks.
The thousands of layers of shields would eventually melt away in the blue flames. Annihilating the troops afterward was not a challenging task for the current Jin.
But since the Origin Stone would keep generating troops, the strategic move was to penetrate deeper into Eternal Flames.
[We'll support the Lord. Draw your sword.]
Not referring to the crew's swords. What Liet meant was for the ship Sara to draw its sword.
Thump, thud-! Creeeak!
The form of the ship Sara was transforming. The long armors enveloping the main cannon unfolded like wings and swept back across the hull.
Subsequently, the main cannon discharged Light energy, forming a shield-like protective barrier in front of the hull, and two gigantic blades emerged from the top and bottom of the cannon.
Both the shield and the blades were wrapped in Eternal Flames. The runes illuminating the hull deepened in color, and the heat of the blue flames Tess was pouring out intensified further.
[Charge!]
A rapid acceleration, powered by the maximum explosion of the heart of light energy, followed by a series of short-range spatial leaps.

Ignoring its massive mass and volume, the ship Sara shot forward like light. In the blink of an eye, there were five spatial leaps, and with each passage of the ship Sara through a dimensional gate, circular shockwaves distorted space, covering the sky.
Even the golden ships scattered nearby vibrated from the powerful shockwaves, but the Eternal Flames between Jin and the ship Sara remained undisturbed.
The clash occurred in an instant.
Without time for Ziffle to reinforce its shields, the two blades of the ship Sara pierced through thousands of layers of protective barriers around the Tower of Story in a flash.
The ship Sara impaled itself diagonally like a spear into the outer armor of the Tower of Story. The troops nearby turned to ash without even a chance to scream.
The Tower of Story tilted momentarily under the immense impact. Yet, astonishingly, none of it was transmitted inside the ship Sara.
Not even the armor showed any sign of cracking. The ship Sara was already preparing for the next attack.
[Reopen the main cannon, pour all power into it, excluding the escape propulsion.]
Click, clack! The main cannon was drawn out again through the hole the blades had made. Close-range bombardment, relentless loading, and firing ensued.
When the cannon fired inside the Tower's hull, instead of an explosion, a sound akin to the crushing of a gigantic beast's bones echoed.

Had it been the aerial fortress of the Red Plutonian, it would have been the end by now. However, the Tower of Story was drawing power from the Origin Stone and the 'sanctuary' fused with the tower, the power of the sun god.
The magicians dying from the bombardment's impact were smiling, as if to say that such an extent could not bring down the tower.
As expected by Jin, when the ship Sara and Eternal FLames entered the interior of the shield, no sight of troop regeneration was observed.
Although one side of the hull directly hit by close-range bombardment was being destructed crazily, it could not be considered a fundamental strike to the tower.
Originally, the Tower of Story was not entirely composed of real minerals and goods like the golden fleet. Most of its structure was made up of magical power and the authority of the Origin Stone.
'Only the central part and its vicinity containing the core would be real. The Tower of Story still retains its original appearance.'
Infinite magical power and authority formed from the Origin Stone. Jin thought of one person who would be operating it with such power.
Elona Ziffle.
The grand magician of Ziffle who feared harming the world, but essentially, her true nature was a fragment of destruction, Malugia.
'Elona, can I not feel any evil from you now because a human heart still remains, or have you become a pure incarnation of destruction?'
Regardless of the truth, it would be unhearable until Ziffle is brought down.
Eternal Flames expanded centered around Jin. From the start, it was already large enough to encircle an entire fleet, but now it seemed poised to consume more than 30% of the Tower of Story' hull.

"Kelliark, you must have done a good job nurturing the Origin Stone with that cunning head of yours. It seems the Origin Stone is not yet as fearful of me as Gliac. Seeing it not scream in terror like during the Battle of Sword Emperor."
A low voice, yet audible to everyone on the battlefield as if right beside them.
Kelliac was observing through a crystal ball, and Jin looked up at the sky at that moment, locking eyes with Kelliark, who was hiding in the central part of the Tower.
"But today, I must hear the Origin Stone scream. It's my first day leading the fleet to tear you apart, and I can't show my face if I don't even hear that."
They are trying to escape.
Even when Eternal Flames first showed it could suppress some of the Origin Stone's power, and when the ship Sara instantly breached the shield and expanded Eternal Flames into the interior with Jin.
Jin was certain that Ziffle was preparing to flee.
From the start, when only the Divine Fleet was chasing them, Ziffle had always avoided a direct confrontation. All they need now is time.
Eternal Flames covering the Tower of Story' hull felt teeming.
Due to resistance. The tower kept  trying to perform spatial leaps as before, but slowed down, caught in the net of Eternal Flames.
As the resistance intensified by the second.
Sssss, kwaah-!

Following the ship Sara, two more ships rammed into the Tower of Story. The Divine Fleet's flagship, Laprarosa, and Runkandel's 2nd flagship, Diana, were those ships. Ban and Luna were emerging from the bridges of each flagship.
Just as the ship Sara enhanced Eternal Flames, the golden fleet's bombardment could support the Plutonian Domination Sword.
"All fleets, resume firing. I will prepare to unfold the Plutonian Domination Sword."
Upon Ban's order, all fleets in the alliance began to gather Light energy to their cannons aga
in.
And Luna, with a hint of regret, shrugged her shoulders and said,
"My Crimson Sword may lack support. Well, I guess I have no choice but to vent my anger on Ziffle."
